findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_started, get_my_details, add_asset, update_asset, delete_asset, add_family_member, update_family_member, delete_family_member, complete_my_assets, get_alignment, set_allocation, review_financial_view, review_partner_property, complete_alignment_step, complete_alignment · Private data: list_documents, read_document · Public sink: get_my_details, update_phone, request_email_change, ask_clara, add_asset, update_asset, delete_asset, add_family_member, update_family_member, delete_family_member, complete_my_assets, set_allocation, complete_alignment_step, read_agreement, invite_partner, resend_partner_invite, update_partner_invite · Destructive: get_quiz_question, answer_quiz_question, delete_asset, delete_family_member, review_financial_view.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_started, get_my_details, add_asset, update_asset, delete_asset, add_family_member, update_family_member, delete_family_member, complete_my_assets, get_alignment, set_allocation, review_financial_view, review_partner_property, complete_alignment_step, complete_alignment · Private data: list_documents, read_document · Public sink: get_my_details, update_phone, request_email_change, ask_clara, add_asset, update_asset, delete_asset, add_family_member, update_family_member, delete_family_member, complete_my_assets, set_allocation, complete_alignment_step, read_agreement, invite_partner, resend_partner_invite, update_partner_invite · Destructive: get_quiz_question, answer_quiz_question, delete_asset, delete_family_member, review_financial_view

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
